summary: Rezones 43.16 acres from 30th Avenue South and West End Avenue to Natchez Trace, south to 31st Avenue South, and along 31st Avenue South, Vanderbilt Place, and 30th Avenue South, to SP zoning for a mixed-use development. It limits uses to those in the MUI-A district plus a few additions, bans some uses such as check cashing and car washes, and allows up to 120 short term rental units outside Subdistrict A.
